title: In silico-based investigation of the molecular mechanism of Artocarpus communis seed hexane fraction against metabolic syndrome.
authors: Elbasyouni, Amel; Prabhu, Dhamodharan; Akindoyin, Emmanuel Oluwatofunmi; Adebiyi, Victor Gbolahan; Aremu, Blessing Misturat; Ilori, Cornelius Toluwase; Olagookun, Favour Inijesunimi; Ogunlakin, Akingbolabo Daniel; Adesanya, Enitan Omobolanle
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络药理学和分子对接/模拟探究植物提取物成分与代谢综合征相关蛋白（STAT3等）的结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: CONTEXT: The medications for metabolic syndromes are very minimal and the available are not effective and show adverse effects. There is a huge need for the development of effective and safe drugs to battle metabolic syndromes. In this context, our study aimed to decipher the key molecules from Artocarpus communis seed hexane fraction and their possible mechanism of action against metabolic syndrome. Network pharmacology and hub gene analysis revealed that STAT3 displayed the highest number of interactions with 56 genes compared to its counterparts HSP90AA1 (51 interactions) and EP300 (42 interactions). The molecular docking analysis revealed a suitable phytochemical with a higher binding affinity towards the three target genes (STAT3, HSP90AA1, and EP300), which were taken further for the molecular dynamic simulations. Overall, the simulation results depict that all the phytochemicals were stably bound within the cavity of the respective target proteins. Therefore, Artocarpus communis seed hexane fraction can potentially alleviate metabolic syndrome in humans. METHODS: Solvent-based extraction was performed in this study to extract the phytochemicals in Artocarpus communis seed powder. The hexane fraction was subjected to GCMS analysis to identify the constituents. ADMETlab 3.0 was used in ADME predictions. Gene databases (GeneCards, Pharos, NCBI-gene, and DisGe NET) were used to identify the genes for the study. STRING, DAVID, and KEGG pathways were utilized in this study. PubChem and Protein Databank were used to retrieve the structures of phytochemicals and protein structures. Schrodinger Suite was used for the molecular docking and Desmond 2021-4 was used to simulate the ligand-bound complexes.
abstract_zh:
代谢综合征的可用药物非常有限，且现有药物效果不佳并表现出不良反应。因此，迫切需要开发有效且安全的药物来对抗代谢综合征。在此背景下，本研究旨在解析面包果（Artocarpus communis）种子己烷馏分中的关键分子及其对抗代谢综合征的可能作用机制。网络药理学和枢纽基因分析显示，STAT3 与 56 个基因的相互作用数量最多，相比之下，HSP90AA1（51 个相互作用）和 EP300（42 个相互作用）较少。分子对接分析揭示了一种对三个靶基因（STAT3、HSP90AA1 和 EP300）具有较高结合亲和力的合适植物化学物质，该物质被进一步用于分子动力学模拟。总体而言，模拟结果表明所有植物化学物质均稳定结合在相应靶蛋白的腔体内。因此，面包果种子己烷馏分可能有效缓解人类代谢综合征。

方法：本研究采用溶剂提取法提取面包果种子粉末中的植物化学物质。将己烷馏分进行 GCMS 分析以鉴定其成分。使用 ADMETlab 3.0 进行 ADME 预测。利用基因数据库（GeneCards、Pharos、NCBI-gene 和 DisGeNET）鉴定研究相关基因。本研究使用了 STRING、DAVID 和 KEGG 通路。通过 PubChem 和蛋白质数据库（Protein Databank）获取植物化学物质和蛋白质的结构。使用 Schrodinger Suite 进行分子对接，并使用 Desmond 2021-4 模拟配体结合复合物。
